verdict.rationale: Amplitude's docs mention server-side event sending (HTTP V2 endpoint) and a shared consent model with options to mask sensitive content and honor consent, which implies some capacity for privacy-conscious, non-cookie-dependent tracking, but there is no explicit claim about avoiding third-party cookies or reducing cookie-consent banners. missing for 10: explicit documentation of cookieless/first-party tracking, cookie policy details, or guidance on reducing consent-banner requirements.
